headline: Core contracts verified on Etherscan, public GitHub repo, and ChainSecurity deployment-verification plus multi-round Aave v3 audits from recognized firms

findings.text: Pool proxy 0xC13e21B648A5Ee794902342038FF3aDAB66BE987 is marked 'Contract: Verified' on Etherscan using the EIP-1967 Transparent Proxy pattern. Etherscan resolves and displays the ABI for the implementation contract at 0x5aE329203E00f76891094DcfedD5Aca082a50e1b, indicating the implementation is also verified. PoolAddressesProvider 0x02C3eA4e34C0cBd694D2adFa2c690EECbC1793eE is separately confirmed 'Contract: Verified' on Etherscan. Direct Etherscan fetch of the implementation page was blocked in this run, so implementation verification is derived from the proxy page's ABI resolution rather than a direct fetch.

Public source repo exists at https://github.com/sparkdotfi/sparklend-v1-core, a fork of Aave v3 core with Spark-specific changes. Release v1.0.0 is pinned to commit SHA 8120e49. The repo structure (Aave v3 base with custom interest rate strategy and oracle for sDAI) corresponds to the explorer-visible source remappings referencing lib/aave-v3-core/. Bytecode diff not performed this run; recorded as V2 scope limit.

ChainSecurity conducted a deployment verification of SparkLend dated April 26, 2023, confirming bytecodes matched the repository at deployment time. The sparklend-v1-core repo's v1.0.0 release explicitly lists 'Add ChainSecurity audit'. The base Aave v3 codebase received audits in October 2021 (ABDK, OpenZeppelin, Trail of Bits, PeckShield), December 2021 (SigmaPrime), November 2021–January 2022 (Certora formal verification), and December 2022 (PeckShield, SigmaPrime). SparkLend Advanced and Cap Automator infrastructure have additional ChainSecurity audits. The docs also note Cantina audits. Audit links repository URLs confirmed accessible.

Auditors include ChainSecurity, OpenZeppelin, Trail of Bits, PeckShield, SigmaPrime, and Certora — all broadly recognized Solidity security firms listed in the rubric. This satisfies the recognized-firm requirement.

ChainSecurity's April 2023 deployment verification confirmed bytecodes matched the repository at deployment. SparkLend is described as based on Aave v3 3.0.1 and 3.0.2 with custom sDAI oracle and DAI interest rate strategy. The docs audit page lists multiple additional ChainSecurity and Cantina audits of SparkLend Advanced, covering oracles and governance components added after initial deployment. Whether the currently-deployed implementation (0x5aE329203E) has drifted materially from the audited commit could not be verified via a GitHub diff this run; this is recorded in unknowns but does not downgrade given the depth of audit coverage and the known-stable nature of the Aave v3 core codebase.

Pool proxy (0xC13e21B648A5Ee794902342038FF3aDAB66BE987) uses EIP-1967 Transparent Proxy. Etherscan shows the ABI is served for the implementation at 0x5aE329203E00f76891094DcfedD5Aca082a50e1b (Pool), indicating the implementation is verified on the explorer. Direct fetch of the implementation page was blocked; verification is derived from the proxy page's ABI resolution.

steelman.red: If the implementation contract 0x5aE329203E00f76891094DcfedD5Aca082a50e1b is not independently verified on Etherscan (only the proxy is), and no diff between the audited commit and current deployment was performed, the protocol's effective verification posture cannot be confirmed.
steelman.orange: The ChainSecurity deployment verification was issued in April 2023; the currently-deployed implementation address (0x5aE329203E) was previously recorded by Etherscan as having superseded 0xb40f6d584081ac2b0fd84c846dba3c1417889304, suggesting a post-audit implementation upgrade whose audit coverage was not confirmed in this run via a diff.
steelman.green: Pool proxy and PoolAddressesProvider are confirmed verified on Etherscan; the implementation ABI is resolved by the proxy page indicating implementation verification; the public GitHub repo (sparkdotfi/sparklend-v1-core) exists with pinned commit SHA 8120e49 at v1.0.0; ChainSecurity (recognized firm) performed a deployment verification confirming bytecode-to-repo match; multiple further recognized-firm audits cover Aave v3 core and Spark-specific extensions.

rationale.verdict: Choosing green because (1) both the proxy contract and its current implementation are verified on Etherscan (the proxy page resolves and displays the implementation ABI, per evidence from the Etherscan search result), (2) a public source repo with a pinned release commit exists at sparkdotfi/sparklend-v1-core, (3) ChainSecurity — a recognized firm — conducted a deployment verification confirming bytecode-repo correspondence at the April 2023 launch, and (4) the Aave v3 codebase underlying SparkLend was audited by Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, PeckShield, SigmaPrime, and Certora. The orange steel-man (post-audit implementation upgrade) is noted in unknowns but is insufficient to downgrade without evidence of material drift from a fund-custody-critical change, given the extensive layered audit coverage and the stable nature of the Aave v3 core.

evidence.shows: Pool proxy 0xC13e21B648A5Ee794902342038FF3aDAB66BE987 is marked 'Contract: Verified' on Etherscan; uses EIP-1967 Transparent Proxy pattern with implementation at 0x5aE329203E00f76891094DcfedD5Aca082a50e1b (Pool); ABI is resolved for the implementation, indicating implementation verification. Previously pointed to implementation 0xb40f6d584081ac2b0fd84c846dba3c1417889304.

PoolAddressesProvider 0x02C3eA4e34C0cBd694D2adFa2c690EECbC1793eE is marked 'Contract: Verified' on Etherscan; source visible as PoolAddressesProvider from Aave v3 (BUSL-1.1), includes InitializableImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy pattern.
Public GitHub repo sparkdotfi/sparklend-v1-core exists; v1.0.0 release pinned at commit SHA 8120e49; release notes confirm 'Add ChainSecurity audit'; v1.0.0-beta.0 at SHA 317efdb.

ChainSecurity deployment verification dated April 26, 2023: assessed whether SparkLend follows Aave V3 deployment procedure; bytecodes confirmed to match the repository for Pool, Treasury, and oracle contracts; sDAI oracle bytecode matches the repository.

sparklend-v1-core is publicly accessible; lists audits: V3.0.1 Dec 2022 (PeckShield, SigmaPrime); V3 Round 1 Oct 2021 (ABDK, OpenZeppelin, Trail of Bits, PeckShield); V3 Round 2 Dec 2021 (SigmaPrime); Formal Verification Nov 2021–Jan 2022 (Certora).

SparkLend audit page lists audit repositories: sparklend-v1-core/audits, sparklend-advanced/audits, sparklend-cap-automator/audits. Notes ChainSecurity completed deployment audits for core, custom DAI interest rate strategy, and sDAI oracle. Links to Immunefi bug bounty program (up to $5M).

ChainSecurity audit of SparkLend Advanced infrastructure, covering price oracles (fixed-price, capped, wstETH, rETH, weETH, rsETH, ezETH, spETH), peg ratio oracles, and interest rate strategies used alongside the SparkLend core market.

ChainSecurity audit of SparkLend Cap Automator covering supply/borrow cap management; identified and resolved issue with zero-cap bypass of cooldown; concluded codebase provides a good level of security.

unknowns: V2: Bytecode diff between deployed implementation 0x5aE329203E00f76891094DcfedD5Aca082a50e1b and sparklend-v1-core repo commit 8120e49 was not performed this run; commit SHA pinned from release page but not cross-referenced against Etherscan-visible source hash.

V5: Post-audit implementation upgrade noted (Etherscan shows previous implementation 0xb40f6d584081ac2b0fd84c846dba3c1417889304 was superseded by 0x5aE329203E00f76891094DcfedD5Aca082a50e1b); diff content between audited commit and current implementation not sampled; could not confirm whether a follow-up audit covered the upgrade delta.

V6: Direct Etherscan fetch of implementation contract 0x5aE329203E00f76891094DcfedD5Aca082a50e1b was blocked; implementation verification is derived (proxy page resolves implementation ABI) rather than directly confirmed.

protocol_metadata.about: SparkLend is a lending and borrowing protocol on Ethereum (and Gnosis/xDai) that allows users to supply collateral assets, borrow against them, and earn yield. It is based on the Aave v3 codebase (including v3.0.1 and v3.0.2 upgrades) with Spark-specific customizations including a custom DAI interest rate strategy tied to the Sky Savings Rate and a bespoke sDAI price oracle. Positions are represented as spTokens (interest-bearing supply tokens) and variable-debt tokens, governed through MakerDAO/Sky governance via a timelock executor.
